verdict.rationale: Yapily documents webhooks that send real-time HTTP notifications of platform events, plus scheduled, periodic and variable recurring payments. Webhooks are a developer building block a user would have to wire to their own logic, and schedules are time-based rather than event-triggered. Nothing shows a product-native way to define rules that automatically trigger actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
